title: Psychosomatic burden, literacy and stigma of suicide, literacy and attitudes towards psychotherapy and resources in German medical students
summary: The aim of this research project is to investigate psychosomatic stress, health literacy regarding suicidality and psychotherapy, and resources in a population of medical students.
conditions: No catalog or coding system is used in the study. Students are surveyed on psychosomatic health, attitudes and knowledge regarding suicidality, mental disorders, and psychotherapy, as well as their own resources.

interventions.name: Medical students from three cohorts (1st, 3rd, and 5th year of study) will be surveyed for psychosomatic burden, literacy and stigma of suicide, literacy and attitudes towards psychotherapy and resources at three points in time between 2025 and 2027, each at the beginning of the winter semester (Oct

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:

Exclusion criteria:
No other exclusion criteria
